title: Use shape-aware targets for Engram boot recovery
outcome: Boot recovery builds targets through the parent-shaped path instead of the shape-aware nested delegation selector used by normal bind. Correctness currently depends on insertion order.
acceptance: Boot recovery selects the effective Engram target by delegation shape for nested children and has a regression independent of record iteration order.
